legal.notice: CoreBiz issues delivery notes: internal documents with no fiscal value.

demo.title: Try CoreBiz
demo.intro: We give you your own copy of the system, with data from a sample shop. You can touch everything.
demo.pointOwnCopy: It is your copy: nobody else sees what you do.
demo.pointExpires: The account and everything you record are deleted after 24 hours.
demo.orSignUp: Would you rather start with your real business?
demo.rateLimited: You created a demo recently. Try again in a while, or use the one you already have.
demo.pointCredentials: We give you a username and a password: you sign in like an employee would.
demo.credentialsHint: Write them down if you want to come back later. There is no way to recover them.
demo.expiresIn: This account and everything you record are deleted in {hours} hours.
demo.readonlyNotice: A lot of demos are open right now, so you are in read-only mode: you can see everything, but not save changes. Come back later for your own copy.
demo.unavailable: The demo could not be prepared. Please try again in a moment.
demo.sessionNotice: You are trying CoreBiz. This account and its data are deleted in {hours} hours.
demo.sessionNoticeSoon: You are trying CoreBiz. This account and its data are deleted in less than an hour.
demo.templateNotice: You are in the sample shop. It is the copy cloned for every visitor, so whatever you record here will be seen by the next ones.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Catalogue and inventory
products.name: Name
products.taxableHint: The informational tax configured for the company is applied to it.
products.trackStockHint: Deducted when sold, and warns below the minimum. A service does not need it.
products.belowMinimum: {count, plural, one {# product is below its minimum} other {# products are below their minimum}}.
products.empty: No products in the catalogue yet.
products.skuHint: Leave it blank and we generate one. Or type the shelf label or barcode.

products.showArchived: Also show the ones out of the catalogue
products.noMovements: No movements for this product yet.

deliveryNotes.title: Delivery notes
deliveryNotes.subtitle: Outbound goods documents
deliveryNotes.notesHint: Whatever needs saying: delivery instructions, agreements with the customer…
deliveryNotes.printHint: In the dialog, choose “Save as PDF” to get the file.
deliveryNotes.deliverExplain: Records that the customer received the goods. Stock does not change: it left the warehouse when the note was issued.
deliveryNotes.receivedByHint: Name of whoever signs for it (optional)
deliveryNotes.voidExplain: Note {number} keeps its number and its history. The stock that left returns to the warehouse, and the document stays on record marked as voided with the reason you write.
deliveryNotes.voidReasonHint: Wrong quantity, customer returned the goods…
deliveryNotes.needsRateTitle: Set your exchange rate before issuing
deliveryNotes.needsRateDetail: Every note stores the rate of the day it was issued, so the bolívar total is still right six months later. That is why we cannot make one up: tell us once and you are ready to go.

auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Longer is better.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email and password of your account.
login.demoHint: Just want to see how it works?

signup.title: Create account
signup.subtitle: Three fields and you are in. Everything else is set up later.
signup.businessHint: This is the name printed on your delivery notes.
signup.checkEmail: We sent you an email to confirm your account. Open it and you are in.
signup.closedBody: Sign-up is not open on this installation. You can walk through the whole system with your own copy, without giving any details.

forgot.title: Recover access
forgot.subtitle: Type your email and we will send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If that address has an account, the link is on its way. Check your inbox.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Type the password you want to use from now on.

onboarding.title: Set up your business
onboarding.subtitle: Four details and you can start selling. All of them can be changed later in Settings.
onboarding.exchangeRateHint: If you sell in two currencies, enter it now: without it no delivery notes can be issued. You can leave it blank and add it later.
